benefits.text:
BBIA Glow Tint is a glossy lip tint that helps create a clear, plump-looking and naturally fresh layer of color on the lips. The light, fluid tint texture is easy to blend and easy to adjust in intensity: apply a thin layer for a soft everyday glossy-lip effect, or build up more layers for a more vivid, radiant color. The product helps lips look fuller, softer and more lively without making the overall makeup feel heavy, and suits many makeup styles, from natural and feminine to bright seasonal looks.

With a smooth glossy finish and clear lip color, BBIA Glow Tint is a good choice for anyone who wants an easy-to-use lip tint that offers plump-looking shine while keeping a light feel on the lips. It can be used alone for a naturally fresh lip effect or layered with other lip products to add shine, a juicier look and depth of color.

howToUse.text:
Apply evenly to the lips for a natural, soft color. 
Can be applied in multiple layers to increase intensity and color longevity.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.
